WITH invoice_costs AS (
    SELECT
        invoice_number,
        SUM(derived_product_cost) AS product_cost_sum,
        SUM(derived_total_cost) AS total_cost_sum,
        COUNT(*) AS line_item_count
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items
    GROUP BY invoice_number
), invoice_ratios AS (
    SELECT
        invoice_number,
        product_cost_sum / NULLIF(total_cost_sum, 0) AS cost_ratio,
        line_item_count
    FROM invoice_costs
), ratios_with_average AS (
    SELECT
        invoice_number,
        cost_ratio,
        line_item_count,
        AVG(cost_ratio) OVER () AS average_cost_ratio
    FROM invoice_ratios
)
SELECT
    invoice_number,
    cost_ratio,
    line_item_count,
    cost_ratio / NULLIF(average_cost_ratio, 0) AS relative_ratio
FROM ratios_with_average
WHERE average_cost_ratio IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY relative_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: A zero sum of derived_total_cost makes that invoice's cost ratio undefined; a zero overall average makes relative ratios undefined, and division by zero is avoided.
